reviewFindings: The one-shot recovery predicate is contact-safe: WAITING + interrupted non-contact frame only; accepted/preserved visiblePulseId contact is excluded, including zero-material accepted contact.

The exact owner delta is durable but remains a patch artifact. It is not existing-owner wiring proof and must not be reported as implemented OperatorOverlayService behavior.
